name: Digireach Estates - Weekly Unconverted Lead Nurture Sequence

parameters.query:
-- Fetch leads with completed visits older than 7 days who have not booked a unit yet
SELECT 
  v.id, 
  v.name, 
  v.phone, 
  v.project_name, 
  v.project_type,
  p.construction_progress_pct,
  p.price_start
FROM public.site_visits v
LEFT JOIN public.projects p ON v.project_id = p.id
WHERE v.status = 'completed'
  AND v.date <= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 100;
